Although it generates positive operating income with an 8% margin and estimated interest coverage is adequate (around 6x, based on typical tax rates), the persistent negative retained earnings of -8,881 million and leverage issues point to a high probability of default. These factors align with speculative-grade ratings, particularly the B category due to the severe balance sheet weaknesses despite operational profitability.

DECISION: B
